decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the newly required consistency and froth preservation; no additional update is needed.
Changing the spout geometry to preserve froth does not alter the existing no-drip, sealing, or leak-containment requirements.
The source does not change the required open/close control behavior or closed-state drip prevention.
The source concerns beverage behavior through the spout and does not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the selected size reference.
The requested spout geometry change does not modify the requirement that the spout be removable or easy to flush and clean.
Spout geometry and froth preservation do not affect the 120V wall-powered electrical architecture.
The client requests a spout design revision but does not change the requirement to provide a prototype bill of materials or establish a specific replacement BOM item.
The source does not change the V1 strategy of using simple off-the-shelf components.
The source changes spout geometry but does not revise enclosure size, side profile, or accommodation of deep bowl wells.
The spout revision does not change the DJ turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source does not modify the beige primary color or green accent color.
Concern about consistency and froth loss during dispensing does not change the separate splash-control target for mixing operation.
